name: balancer
description: Shares delegated subagent work between Claude and the local Codex CLI so both subscriptions are used at a similar pace.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: auto balances by runway; claude, codex or off force the route

margin.title: Margin
margin.description: Runway points Codex must lead by

ceilingFiveHour.title: 5-hour ceiling
ceilingFiveHour.description: Do not route to a provider at or above this 5-hour use (percent)

ceilingSevenDay.title: Weekly ceiling
ceilingSevenDay.description: Do not route to a provider at or above this weekly use (percent)

eligibleAgentTypes.title: Eligible agent types
eligibleAgentTypes.description: Comma-separated subagent types that may run on Codex

excludedAgentTypes.title: Excluded agent types
excludedAgentTypes.description: Comma-separated subagent types that always stay on Claude, even in codex mode

excludedModels.title: Excluded models
excludedModels.description: Comma-separated Claude models (alias such as fable, or a full id of that family) whose calls always stay on Claude, even in codex mode

effortMap.title: Effort map
effortMap.description: Agent model to Codex reasoning effort, as model=effort pairs

modelMap.title: Model map
modelMap.description: Agent model to Codex model, as model=model pairs

codexModel.title: Codex model
codexModel.description: Codex model for unmapped Agent calls and /codex; empty keeps Codex's default

maxConcurrentCodex.title: Max concurrent Codex tasks
maxConcurrentCodex.description: Across all sessions on this machine

staleAfterMinutes.title: Stale after (minutes)
staleAfterMinutes.description: Age at which a Codex reading is refreshed

claudeTaskCostFiveHour.title: Claude task cost, 5-hour
claudeTaskCostFiveHour.description: Points of the 5-hour window per task

claudeTaskCostSevenDay.title: Claude task cost, weekly
claudeTaskCostSevenDay.description: Points of the weekly window per task

nudge.title: Nudge
nudge.description: Inject the delegation nudge when Claude is tight
